launches.title: QFEX - The Global 24/7 Stock Exchange
launches.tagline: Direct, 24/7, leveraged trading on US equities, commodities and FX.
launches.body:
Hello World! We’re [Annanay](https://www.linkedin.com/in/annanay-kapila/) and [Joshua](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshua-wharton/), and we’re building [QFEX](http://www.qfex.com/): a global, 24/7 stock exchange.

#### **What We’ve Built**

Trillions of dollars change hands every day in the global financial markets, but the pace of innovation is excruciatingly slow. As of 2025, you still can’t:

* Trade directly on an exchange **without a broker** (unless you’re as big as Jane Street).
* **Trade 24/7**.
* Get **>20x leverage** or avoid margin fees.
* Trade leveraged US stocks without **worrying about options**.

We’re changing this.

We’ve built an exchange that provides all of the above, packaged into a sleek, **direct-to-market** interface with one-of-a-kind purely **volume-based fees**. Bye-bye Robinhood selling your orders for Citadel to front-run. Adios to the Interactive Brokers GUI. Hello to markets as they _should_ **be**.

https://www.tella.tv/video/joshuas-video-1m32

https://www.tella.tv/video/joshuas-video-32cb

#### **Call To Action**

QFEX is currently running in a closed beta with a white-glove service to match user enthusiasm. To get earlier access: 

* **Sign up** to our [waitlist](https://app.qfex.com/login) to get invited!
* Follow us on socials to make sure you don’t miss out on any early access perks! [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/user/TradeQFEX/) [Twitter](https://x.com/TradeQFEX) [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/tradeqfex) [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/entimox/)
* [API](https://docs.qfex.com/) traders - welcome to the first API-native exchange! Reach out [here](mailto:hello@pfex.com) to schedule onboarding.
* Share this post with anyone interested in trading, exchanges or crypto! 

#### **The Team**

We met at Cambridge studying Maths in 2016, and the rest is history. Working as Quants and Engineers at Tower Research and Citadel before YC, we spent a year trying to figure out why crypto exchanges can solve all of the above, but traditional exchanges can’t. We still haven’t found a convincing answer.

#### **PS - For the Crypto/ Finance Bros**

Taking a leaf out of the crypto world, [QFEX](http://www.qfex.com/) is listing Perpetual Futures in traditional assets, making it the first exchange to do so. Futures haven’t changed since the first standardized contract was made in 1865 to help farmers hedge their corn harvests. Now S&P500 futures trade $500 billion daily, but it still expires in time for the harvest. Why?

[QFEX](http://www.qfex.com/) will save institutional traders billions of dollars in rolling costs, operational headache, and deeper liquidity from an unfragmented market - just like perps did for crypto.

name: Kimpton
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description:
In investment management, every decision gets graded. The market prints the answer on a date known in advance, and nobody gets to argue with it.

Kimpton is financial AI that answers to reality. Kimpton OS is the AI-native operating system for investment teams: it does the research and hands PMs structured trades. EarningsBench is a public benchmark where models forecast quarterly earnings before companies report and the reported numbers do the scoring. Koliseum is the set of point-in-time financial environments we build from that work, for labs to train and evaluate models on.

The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding into passive. AI was supposed to fix that, but it hasn't. Funds either stitch together a dozen point tools or babysit general agents all day, and neither gets them to the trade.

Kimpton OS goes straight to it. It ingests a fund's mandate, strategy, and positions, connects to the institutional data the fund already runs on, and returns a structured trade proposal built for that fund. It's built to disagree, because consensus is poison for investment decisions. Instead of telling a PM what they want to hear, it surfaces the breaches and risks they'd otherwise miss.

That same work is how we grade AI. Static benchmarks leak into training data. Simulations reward what their authors imagined. A forecast sealed before the outcome exists and scored when the company reports can't be rehearsed or backdated. We started in markets because they're the one place reality answers on schedule.

We're two ex-Goldman engineers and an ex-SpaceX engineer. We left to start our own quantitative systematic hedge fund, raised $10M from a family office at 21 and 22, and scaled it to $35M over four years. We learned to trust live results over historical fit. We built Kimpton inside that fund, then productized the stack.

We're live with our first institutional client, a $3.3B manager. Our first market is fundamental equity funds from $1B to $10B, and the labs that need to know whether their models can do this work.

launches.title: Koliseum by Kimpton, Live Evaluation Arenas for AI Models
launches.tagline: Real-world market interaction environments, starting with financial markets
launches.body:
Today we're launching **Koliseum** by [Kimpton](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/31420), live evaluation arenas for AI models in financial work.

**The problem**

Static benchmarks are contaminated soon after publication, and simulations reward the assumptions their designers encode. 

This simply isn't acceptable in finance or any other professional industry. A wrong answer or action can be catastrophic and reality eventually shows whether the claim was right. Almost no evaluation waits to find out.

**Koliseum**

Before Kimpton, we ran a quantitative fund. Backtests never proved alpha; live markets did. Koliseum applies the same test to models: a model commits inside an arena, the record is sealed, and reality supplies the grade.

Two kinds of arenas:

* **Prediction Arenas** seal a forecast before the outcome exists and score it against consensus, market, and statistical baselines when reality resolves.
* **Action Arenas** give a model a bounded task and real tools, then verify success from the resulting system state.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=113565&key=user_uploads/3054189/789d031b-cca8-4596-8921-dbc9f1544cb4)

The first Prediction Arena is already running. **EarningsBench** seals earnings forecasts for public companies 24 hours before each release and scores them against consensus and a statistical baseline once results are public.

Two things are already clear: most open-weight models reproduce consensus exactly, and a simple statistical baseline is harder to beat than a leaderboard alone would suggest.

Along with these developments, we are introducing a new concept in evaluation: **reality-as-a-judge**.

![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=113565&key=user_uploads%2F3054189%2Fc6c1ba2c-4e77-4ebc-be71-675f0abd71a6&variant=large)

Most open-ended evaluations are graded by another model or by a human rubric, so the score inherits the grader's assumptions. In reality-as-a-judge, the grader is the outcome itself.

[More info on Koliseum](https://www.kimpton.ai/koliseum)

[Methodology](https://www.kimpton.ai/methodology)

**Our ask**

Reach out if:

* You work on post-training or evals at a lab and want your model in the first private cohort. Results stay private unless you publish them.
* You run a trading firm or a prediction venue and want models scored on your own resolving questions, or want to co-run a public arena.
* You have a workflow (any industry!) with a verifiable end state and want it turned into an Action Arena.

or know anyone who does.

Write to us at [founders@kimpton.ai](mailto:founders@kimpton.ai). Thanks for the support!

launches.title: Kimpton: Cursor for portfolio managers
launches.tagline: AI-native terminal where agents do the research and propose the trades
launches.body:
**TL;DR** AI can’t trade, but portfolio managers can. Kimpton combines high-resolution public financial markets data, portfolio manager strategy/mandate, portfolio holdings, and transaction data to generate trade ideas for managers.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3aED4nL3G50>

**Our Background**

We are former Goldman Sachs and Vistra Energy engineers who started a quantitative hedge fund together in 2021 after raising $10M from a family office at the ages of 22 and 21 years old, scaling it to $35M at its peak.

We spent four years systematically trading using the tools that we built in-house to support our systems. Internally, we developed Kimpton to automate many of our own workflows.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102078&key=user_uploads/3054189/7f252d74-65d7-4557-92f0-59383e3a782a)

**The Problem**

AI can’t trade. After all, LLMs are the most overfit backtest in all of human history. They are consensus machines and sycophantic by nature. As a result, AI goes largely unused by portfolio managers today.

Agents finally had depth in 2025. We tested LLMs on the markets and were unimpressed with the output. LLMs can’t trade because they are consensus machines and sycophantic by nature. They lack the edge that portfolio managers provide.

AI can’t trade like a portfolio manager, but they can research at 100X the efficiency of an investment analyst. For this reason, Kimpton revolves around the portfolio manager, solving increasingly all of the workflows that they need.

Analysts spend weeks aggregating data and synthesizing it to generate singular trade ideas that are passed up to portfolio managers for review. It’s time for a change.

Investment management is built on the idea that analysts and PMs need to spend their days staring at screens all day to find edge in the markets. 

To refactor the investment management industry, we can’t simply provide better tools. We have to automate the entire research layer instead.

**The Solution**

Kimpton automates the analysis layer by securely ingesting firm-wide context, portfolio, and transaction data to synthesize fully-formed trade recommendations fitted to their portfolio.

Portfolio managers can challenge the results of the trade proposals through a process we call Adversarial Review, an agentic Socratic questioning to assist portfolio managers in coming to their own conclusions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102078&key=user_uploads/3054189/62ecf56b-91f8-4c4d-a883-6a8be7df6108)

We developed a harness specifically for the financial markets to make aggregation efficient, fast, and accurate. It has access to high-quality institutional data sources through Factset, Massive, and Tiingo. Real-time data on tens of thousands of global assets across equities, ETFs, indices, insider trades, SEC filings, events, transcripts, company fundamentals, corporate leadership, and more!

Our AI agents also provide portfolio managers with the ability to generate many different types of artifacts, such as real-time dashboards, institutional-grade reports, and comprehensive visualizations.

**Traction**

Kimpton is deployed and generating trade proposals on billions of dollars of assets under management today.

Portfolio managers are using Kimpton to monitor their exposures, understand investment thesis drift, earnings coverage, manage positioning across teams, investor reporting, and as an investment team collective brain.

Portfolio managers are underserved today when the potential to refactor the way they work is massive. Kimpton is focused on improving the lives portfolio managers who are actively making decisions in the public markets.

**Ask**

If you know anyone who manages assets a hedge fund, family office, mutual fund, ETF manager, or other public markets manager — we’d love to speak with them.

launches.body:
**TL;DR** Prodigy Research is an AI lab that has trained the world's best foundation model for quantitative finance. We’ve already achieved 140% returns in live trading over the course of our YC batch, while major indices like the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq were flat or down.

**Traction**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109747&key=user_uploads/3203618/c02ef51e-f0e4-43b8-a335-b55e66d5afd2)

Our model beats Claude Fable and GPT-5.6 Sol at financial and quant research tasks. Prodigy's strategies are delta-neutral, and thanks to our rigorous and comprehensive risk controls, we've never had a down week.

**Why Now**

launches.title: Spectre Intelligence - a neotrading firm
launches.tagline: We're an AI trading research firm, currently in semiconductors and biotech.
launches.body:
TL;DR: Spectre Capital is a multi-strategy trading firm run by AI agents, not human analysts. We deploy real capital to capture every decision, reasoning trace, and ground-truth outcome, so our agents learn and compound from every mistake. Most AI trading labs pay egregious amounts for training data. Ours pays us when we win.

We left Harvard after starting a hedge fund from our college dorm (go Currier!).

Now we’re building Spectre Intelligence, a neotrading firm training superhuman AI traders. 

**The problem**

Intelligence is getting cheaper, and it will rewire trading. But the scarcest input to markets isn't compute or data feeds or latency, but rather judgment. That data is fragmented, scarce, and the foundation of entire careers. It is also entirely proprietary and guarded fiercely by firms.

**What we do**

We collect judgment by trading live. Every position our agents take generates decisions, full reasoning traces, and ground-truth P&L. We think this is the ultimate alignment of incentives in one of the largest TAMs in the world.

The structure is evolutionary from first principles: open competition inside each pod, and strategies and pods are born and killed constantly. 

Unlike a traditional pod shop, spinning up a new pod costs compute, not headcount. Our agents work superhuman hours, monitor a superhuman number of things, and learn from every real and simulated trade. Our AI traders develop specialized strategies in parallel, allowing us to scale far beyond the limits of human bandwidth. This is an edge that scales, compounds, and isn't held by any one employee.

**Traction**

\- Two live pods: semiconductors and biotech equities. (We picked the verticals, not our AI traders.)

**Why now?**

AI is the worst it will ever be, LLM traders aren't even good yet, but we believe the writing is on the wall and want to be on the frontier. Quant funds were arguably the first agent labs: ML theory embedded for decades, quants as very expensive agents. We're building the generation after.

**The ask**

If any of this resonates, feel free to reach out: michelle@spectreintelligence.ai

We’re also collecting an expert network across semis + biotech, so if you have experience, feel free to join at <https://www.spectreintelligence.ai/experts>

launches.title: Arbital - Trade memes, stocks, and perps from one place
launches.tagline: Trade Anything, Anywhere - 2,700 traders have traded $1.35B in 7 months
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Arbital is a trading terminal for memecoins, stocks, and perps. In our first seven months, 2,700 traders have traded $1.35B through Arbital. We recently hit a record $41M in daily volume and are now doing \~$435M/month in trading volume. \
\
<https://youtu.be/gzAA55qcWzA>

**The problem**

Volatility no longer lives in one market.

On any given day, it might be a memecoin ripping, an AI stock pumping, or a Korean or Chinese stock moving.

But two things get in the way:

* **Discovery is noisy.** Trade ideas are scattered across social feeds, and it's hard to know who's credible or why they're making a trade.
* **Execution is fragmented.** There's no single place to trade every market that matters - crypto, memes, perps, and equities.

Arbital brings traders, trade ideas, and markets into one place.

**What we built**

Arbital is one place to discover and trade the markets you care about most.

With Arbital, you can:

* Trade memecoins, equities, and perps
* Run automated strategies like market making and grid trading

We’re also building a social, mobile-first trading app where users can discover what other traders are buying, understand their reasoning, and execute immediately.

**Traction - first 7 months**

* **$1.35B+** total trading volume
* **$41M** in a single day - a new all-time high
* **\~$435M/month** in trading volume
* **2,700** traders

**Why us**

Before Arbital, we were early team members at Aevo. We helped scale the exchange from \~$1B to $100B in cumulative volume, grew DAU from 1,000 to 30,000 in five months, and helped launch its token, which reached a \~$3.8B peak valuation and is listed on Binance and Bybit.

On the engineering side, we built trading systems that handled 100K events per second with <2ms latency.

Now we're using what we learned to build a simpler trading experience for a global audience.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110390&key=user_uploads/531306/fe17e817-a600-47c9-8476-41dabab20359)

**Our asks**

If you trade memes, perps, or stocks, we'd love for you to try Arbital and tell us what you think. Trader feedback helps us make the product better.\
\

launches.tagline: the first exchange for physical compute where you can buy, sell, use, and hedge GPU capacity for exactly the dates you want
launches.body:
Hi, we're Computable, the first exchange for physical compute where you can buy, sell, and use GPU capacity for exactly the dates you want like staying on Airbnb. You pay less, commit less, and stay flexible.

<https://youtu.be/6HTjUUO__MU>

**The problem**

Compute is the newest major commodity, but it still trades like an asset from the last century. You overpay going in and you eat the weeks you don't use.

**How it works**

We put a public price on every week. Open the market and you'll see dedicated H100 nodes, every week through January 2027, each with its own price, from $2.55/GPU-hr. Pick a start week and an end week, and it's yours.

* **Buy the exact weeks you need.** Two nodes for the last two weeks of October is just a few clicks, and you never pay for weeks you don't want.
* **Sell back what you don't use.** If your plans change, sell the weeks back to the market whenever you want; we keep a market quote posted on every position.
* **Lock next year at a price you can see.** January 2027 is on the grid today, so you know exactly what the future run costs before another H100 40% rate jump happens.
* **Real machines, fast.** Dedicated H100 SXM nodes, full SSH root access, live within an hour of your window start.

**Why us**

Our founding team comes from Jump Trading, Coinbase, Citadel Securities, and other trading firms and exchanges. We have spent our careers building markets. Stay tuned for more products coming soon as we build out the financial infrastructure of the AI economy.

**Our asks**

* **Open [market.getcomputable.com](http://market.getcomputable.com) and buy GPU!**
* **Tell us what to list next: GPU type, region, dates.** Email [team@getcomputable.com](mailto:ray@getcomputable.com); it directly sets what goes on the grid.
* **If GPU prices move your margins or you are worried about your long-term contracts, email [team@getcomputable.com](mailto:ray@getcomputable.com).** We have a super cool product in pipeline for exactly this. Early testers get it first!
